Name: Meadow Farm without ponds and grass
Author: Sneilert
Description:
[img]https://i.imgur.com/Ou4KAZl.png[/img]﻿
This map is a flawless recreation of the latest meadow farm map from version 1.6. I've replaced the grass with tillable sand tiles and eliminated the ponds, providing you with greater freedom and more space to unleash your creativity. Added new map option with ponds but no grass.



[img]https://i.imgur.com/O1IurKN.png[/img]
Three files are optional: one with debris, one without and one with ponds but without grass. You can decide which version you prefer to play on.



[img]https://i.imgur.com/tzy7c89.png[/img]﻿
This map modification necessitates [b]SMAPI[/b] and [b]Content Patcher[/b]. Refer to the included [b]readme file[/b] for [b]installation instructions[/b] if you are new to modding.



[img]https://i.imgur.com/tH1ubw1.png[/img]
